description: This file defines the CohortService interface in the OpenMRS project, providing method signatures for managing cohorts and cohort memberships, including CRUD operations, patient membership management, and cohort queries.

classes.name: CohortService
classes.description: Interface defining API methods for managing patient cohorts and their memberships within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: setCohortDAO
methods.description: Sets the data access object for Cohort operations.

methods.name: saveCohort
methods.description: Creates or updates a Cohort; throws exception if patient IDs do not exist.

methods.name: voidCohort
methods.description: Voids a cohort, marking it as retired with a reason.

methods.name: purgeCohort
methods.description: Permanently deletes a Cohort from the database.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort by its database primary key.

methods.name: getCohortByName
methods.description: Retrieves a non-voided Cohort matching a given name.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Deprecated method, use getCohortByName instead.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Returns all non-voided Cohorts.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Returns all Cohorts, including voided if specified.

methods.name: getCohorts
methods.description: Finds cohorts by partial name matching.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatient
methods.description: Deprecated. Finds Cohorts containing a specific Patient.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatientId
methods.description: Finds Cohorts containing a patient by patient ID.

methods.name: addPatientToCohort
methods.description: Adds a patient to a Cohort, creating membership if not present.

methods.name: removePatientFromCohort
methods.description: Deprecated. Removes a patient from a Cohort.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort by its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a CohortMembership by UUID.

methods.name: purgeCohortMembership
methods.description: Removes a CohortMembership from its parent Cohort.

methods.name: voidCohortMembership
methods.description: Voids a CohortMembership with a reason.

methods.name: endCohortMembership
methods.description: Ends a CohortMembership at a specific date.

methods.name: notifyPatientVoided
methods.description: Internal method to void all CohortMemberships of a voided patient.

methods.name: notifyPatientUnvoided
methods.description: Internal method to unvoid CohortMemberships of an unvoided patient.

methods.name: getCohortMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves CohortMemberships for a patient, optionally active on a specific date and including voided ones.
